# LibreAgent public API snapshot
# Generated by ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh
# Format: one demangled T-binding symbol per line, sorted within each
# section; section header line '== <component> =='. A component's
# section is present only when that component was built for this
# snapshot (LIBREAGENT_BUILD_CORE / LIBREAGENT_BUILD_WIRE /
# LIBREAGENT_BUILD_CLIENT_QT) — see the file header comment in this
# script for the full per-section rationale (why each is filtered the
# way it is, and why the symbol sections are never merged into one).
#
# The 'layout:' section is NOT symbols: it records the SHAPE of the
# public value types (size, alignment, member count, per-member byte
# offsets), because a symbol diff is blind to a member added, removed
# or reordered on a type consumers copy by value. A clean symbol diff
# alone therefore does NOT mean 'no ABI impact' — read both.
# Re-generate with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --update <build_dir>
# Diff a fresh build against this baseline with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --check
== libLibreAgentCore.a ==
